subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Drug addiction is strong attraction for any harmful thing. Drugs has not only a national but also a global problem. These drugs means used for intoxicating and stimulating effects. Addiction are grasped the young generation of the country. taken by smoking or through injection.
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table to make a text (a) Addiction means strong attraction for any harmful thing. (b) Drug addiction is not only a national but also a global problem. (c) Drugs are used for intoxicating and stimulating effects. (d) Drugs are taken by smoking or through injection. (e) These drugs have grasped the young generation of the country.
